description: REQ-307's own 'Canonical call order' (behavioral-spec.md, 'never varied, never partially reordered') pins step 7 = REQ-205's mcp.json write and step 8 = REQ-206's buildChildSpec assembly, strictly in that order. executeSpawnAttempt's actual control flow does the opposite: immediately after step 6 (REQ-204 identity registration) succeeds, it unconditionally calls buildChildSpec({...}) (spawn-orchestrator.mjs:283-292, the exact call the sprint's own test file and contracts/sprint-2.md's own CRIT-203 test both label 'step 8' -- see spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs:236-248's 'PROP-307c step 8' test name) BEFORE the block explicitly commented '// Step 7 (REQ-205): mcp.json write' (spawn-orchestrator.mjs:313-322) ever runs. A control-flow read (the verification method CRIT-201's own passThreshold specifies) confirms this unambiguously: step 8 executes textually and at runtime before step 7, for every attempt, not just failure paths. CRIT-201's passThreshold reads: 'FAIL if a second orchestration path exists, if the canonical order is violated, or if run.sh is touched' -- the canonical order is violated. This also has one genuine (if currently untested) observable consequence: if buildChildSpec's own real distinct-wallet assertion throws (the 'step 8' failure scenario), the function returns immediately, meaning REQ-205's mcp.json is NEVER written for that attempt -- whereas the canonical order (7 before 8) implies mcp.json would already have been written by the time a step-8 failure can occur. No existing test (PROP-307a's call-order test only tracks the 6 deps-injected functions, never buildChildSpec's own call position; PROP-307c's step-7/step-8 tests only assert ledger-row shape, never mcp.json's on-disk state or call order between the two) currently catches this, which is precisely why an independent structural read was needed.

evidence.testName: no existing test asserts step 7/step 8 relative call order or mcp.json on-disk existence after a step-8 (buildChildSpec) failure; behavioral-spec.md's REQ-307 'Canonical call order' items 7-8 and spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs:236-248 ('PROP-307c step 8') read together confirm the violation
